description: Audit the images on any public web page. Returns each image's natural vs rendered dimensions, flags oversized images (downloaded much larger than displayed — a common Largest Contentful Paint problem), and breaks down formats (WebP/AVIF adoption). Useful for web performance and image-optimization work.

oversizedThreshold.description: Area-overshoot ratio above which an image is flagged oversized. Default 4 (≈2x in each dimension).

url.description: The public URL of the page to audit.

name: scan_image_dimensions
title: Scan image dimensions
